Credits & sources

WEBVERSE is an unofficial Spider-Man fan project. Spider-Man names, characters, theatrical posters, and film imagery belong to their respective owners, including Marvel, Sony, and Columbia Pictures. This site is not affiliated with those companies. Sourced images are not claimed as original work.

Home cover and movie posters

The 4K home cover is Spider-Man-inspired action artwork sourced through Wallpapers.com. Its layered frame and pointer tilt are interface effects, not reconstructed character models. Movie posters are sourced from the linked studio pages.

Release information

Film status checked November 10, 2026. The guide includes 11 released theatrical Spider-Man features since 2002 and the announced Beyond the Spider-Verse. U.S. release dates can change. See Sony Pictures and Sony Pictures Animation.

Original interface and games

The rooftop renderer, illustrated Spider-Man, movement and web-rope physics, villain portraits, background web linework, 3D galleries, interface, and game effects were created for this site. No official game assets are used. Progress, course badges, and best times stay in your current browser.
